formation.note: Approval year, used as a lower bound for the collaboration formation.
formation.quote: PEP-004 and PEP-009 were approved in 1977 and merged around 1985 and completed running in 1990.

intervals.label: PEP data taking
intervals.locator: N. J. Hadley, LBL-16116 (1983), section 3.2 (start); AIP catalogue, SLAC-PEP-004-009 (end)
intervals.note: Start (data taking April 1982) from the Hadley thesis; end (completed running 1990) from the AIP catalogue (secondary), so the end year is approximate. PEP-4 and PEP-9 (Two-Gamma) were merged around 1985.
intervals.quote: installed in the PEP beam line in January 1982. Mter further checkout, data taking was started in April 1982.

intervals.label: completed running
intervals.quote: PEP-004 and PEP-009 were approved in 1977 and merged around 1985 and completed running in 1990.

summary.plain: A collaboration led by Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory with UCLA, UC Riverside, UC Santa Barbara, Johns Hopkins, Yale and other institutions that built and ran the PEP-4 time projection chamber, later merged with the Two-Gamma experiment.
summary.technical: PEP-4 TPC collaboration (proposal PEP #4 by Johns Hopkins, LBL, UCLA, UC Riverside and Yale; AIP catalogue lists LBL, SLAC, NIKHEF, Tokyo, UCLA, UC Riverside, UC Santa Barbara, Berkeley, Davis, San Diego, Carnegie-Mellon, Ames, Johns Hopkins, Massachusetts and NYU; spokespeople included D. Nygren, P. Oddone, J. Marx).
